P1.blind: hide pure terminal actions, options, and target treatment mentions in interrogative clause; keep all other source text and all execution qualifications
P1.visible: retain terminal actions, options and embedded question
P1.output: free greedy branch ID 1 or 2; parse failures count incorrect
P1.CS_shortfall: only explicit verified intervals in frozen dev cohort; do not fabricate or duplicate
P1.gate: model-macro mean SW blind accuracy minus visible accuracy >= 3 percentage points; otherwise STOP

P2.stop: large neutral-code effect: revise to visibility narrative

P3.fallback: no concentrated window -> all layers; retain behavioral evidence

P4.stop: repair any failed unit before P5

P5.stop: gate must match gold prune within 2pp; otherwise repair before P6

P6.source: MEGA-CDP single turn, development guidelines only
P6.stage_ablation: judgment x execution 2x2; fixed judgment and evidence in execution comparisons
P6.scoring: freeze before inference; cache by case/output/reference/config; guideline-clustered paired bootstrap
P6.stop: if any substantive gate fails, do not claim all gates passed; revise claims per user protocol

patient_facts: complete original source text; only named target treatments in question clause hidden in blind
execution_qualifications: separate role, visible in both, fixed across variants; entry branch labels unchanged
Qwen_reuse: Only after exact token-ID equivalence across all source prompts and matching model weight SHA256; import P2 only after new P1 passes.
